scale: Blender meters; Unreal centimeters. Standing height 1.80 m (180 cm), feet at ground origin Z=0.
lod_policy: LODs are independent decimated meshes (not three copies of the same mesh), retaining shape, materials, and animation usability. LOD0 authored; LOD1 = 0.5 ratio; LOD2 = 0.25 ratio (decimate applied to rest mesh, skinning retained).

slots: M_CyberMetal (right cyber forearm/hand, blade, power cell, beacon)
M_GlowTeal (emissive accent: emitter glow, cell glow)
M_TeamBlue (team-accent variant 1 emissive; swapped for M_TeamOrange for variant 2)
material_slots.note: Two team-accent variants are delivered as swappable materials (M_TeamBlue default, M_TeamOrange alternate) without replacing the mesh or rig. Accent is distinguishable by emissive outline/icon option, not color alone.

textures.note: All materials are procedurally authored (base color/roughness/metalness/emission via shader nodes). UVs are present (smart-projected, editable islands) for rebaking. No baked image textures ship with the asset; bake textures into the UVs via the provided export tooling if image textures are required.

files.lods: LODs collection inside source/Operative.blend; decimate modifiers retained for rebake
